# REMAINING_WORK

## Active

- Finish the native importer/service-worker reference scan and record its evidence.
- Obtain exact Git commit receipt without disturbing the already-dirty working tree.
- Localize every ordinary selector in `geelooy/style/future-system/` beneath explicit opt-in roots.
- Repair future-system token/color contract gaps and verify reduced-motion/performance scoping.
- Localize all Apps route CSS beneath `body[data-geelooy-route="apps"]`.
- Make Apps layout mobile-first, overflow-safe, safe-area-aware, and locally layered.
- Re-read all rewritten Future System and Apps style files.
- Run selector scope and line-count checks on the rewritten CSS.
- Browser-test Apps at narrow phone, tablet, and desktop widths with focus/hover/active evidence.
- Browser-test at least one additional future-system consumer to prove shared changes did not regress it.
- Audit consumers of `geelooy/index.css`; retire or localize only with live-consumer evidence.
- Audit all importers of `geelooy-app` before changing its `:root` token contract.
- Trace Social Hub local CSS/JS assembly and every DOM ID/query contract before rewriting its dense HTML.
- Audit Home, Docs, and Drive with browser evidence and improve measured defects inside their existing local modules.
- Continue route-family migrations through production pages while excluding archives, generated bundles, and test fixtures unless proven live.
- Refactor JavaScript/API boundaries only where inspection reveals real coupling, lifecycle, data, error, or maintainability defects.
- Preserve the current retired-service-worker architecture unless a live `oyvedEdom.js` caller is proven.
- Update durable documentation and handoff with actual changes and evidence.
- Re-read every touched source artifact after each writing wave.
- Compare PLANNED vs ACTUAL after implementation; every meaningful delta becomes work.
- Run final indentation, syntax, import, style-scope, overflow, interaction, and browser-console verification.

## Blocked

None. A long-running native scan is still active but does not block the fully-read Future System and Apps CSS rewrite wave.

## Completion gate

This file remains non-empty while safe production work discovered inside the requested `geelooy` scope remains unimplemented or unverified.
